note: Reference labels for the unseen recording (plan §12.18), transcribed verbatim from the reviewer's blind adjudication: made from the statements alone, without the author's draft labels or any routing or classifier result. Interpretations, as the reviewer stated them: contradiction — the claims conflict under their stated scope; compatible — both can reasonably hold simultaneously; ambiguous — missing information materially determines whether there is a conflict. Frozen: never edited after the route step.
